root_cause: DeepSWE Step 0 rollout on 128 trajectories (8 groups x 16 generations) required 2 sequential waves under max_concurrency=64. The hard wall-clock timeout of 3600s in agentic_rl_learner.py expired before wave 2 finished, raising TimeoutError and causing client process exit.
remediation: Increase --rollout_batch_timeout_secs and CANON_DEEPSWE_ROLLOUT_BATCH_TIMEOUT_SECS to 7200s (or 9000s) to grant sufficient wall-clock budget for 128 concurrent multi-turn SWE-bench episodes.
